description.text:
1. Automated Test Development & Maintenance
Build and maintain automated test flows for high-end motherboard products using Robot Framework, Python, and C. Monitor CI results, analyze failures, report issues, and drive continuous improvement.
2. Verification Tools & Cross-Platform Applications
Develop and maintain Windows/Linux applications to improve validation efficiency; integrate Raspberry Pi where needed to support unmanned workflows.
3. CI/CD & Infrastructure Support
Contribute to test/production environment setup, deployment, and troubleshooting to enable stable, rapid software delivery.
4. Cross-Team Collaboration
Work with RDs and the automation team to clarify issues, analyze root causes, and coordinate project execution.
◎ Nice to Have
Experience with PHP/MySQL web development and related front-end skills (CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX), plus API/interface development and technical documentation.
